original_record.question: A particular flag is in the shape of a rectangle divided into five smaller congruent rectangles as shown. When written in its lowest terms, the ratio of the side lengths of the smaller rectangle is $\lambda: 1$, where $\lambda<1$. What is the value of $360 \lambda$ ? <image1>
original_record.solution: Let $a, b$ be the side lengths of the smaller rectangle, with $a<b$. We observe that $b=3 a$, so $\lambda=\frac{1}{3}$. The value of $360 \lambda$ is $360 \times \frac{1}{3}=120$.
